user.title: BMS Floor Plan
user.description: Add the BMS Floor Plan panel to the Home Assistant sidebar. It installs next to the previous integration, which keeps working; plans are imported from it with a button.

abort.already_configured: BMS Floor Plan is already set up.

init.title: BMS Floor Plan
init.description: The kiosk is served at /bms-floorplan-kiosk and shows the 3D floor plan only.

data_description.allow_kiosk_exit: A long press in the bottom-right corner opens the full Home Assistant UI under the tablet's account. Leave this off if the tablet is reachable by strangers.

approve.title: Approve a tablet code
approve.description:
Enter the six-digit code the tablet shows. Home Assistant creates a dedicated NON-admin user for this kiosk and gives it its own access, so the tablet keeps working even when nobody has logged into Home Assistant for months.

Codes waiting for approval: {waiting}.

devices.title: Paired kiosks
devices.description: Revoking blocks the kiosk identity, revokes every token of its user and deletes that user. The tablet will then show a fresh pairing code.

error.code_expired: Code not found or expired. Ask the tablet for a new one.
error.invalid_secret: The tablet sent an invalid secret — ask it for a new code.

abort.kiosk_approved: Kiosk approved. The tablet connects by itself within a few seconds.
abort.pairing_unavailable: Pairing is unavailable: restart Home Assistant.
